freeze_batch_norm_2d_module: freeze all BatchNorm2d and SyncBatchNorm layers in a PyTorch module by converting them to FrozenBatchNorm2d
freeze_batch_norm_2d_selective: freeze specific named BatchNorm2d layers in a PyTorch module using a module_match dictionary
to_2tuple_convert: convert a scalar or iterable into a 2-tuple using the to_2tuple utility function
to_4tuple_convert: convert a scalar or iterable into a 4-tuple using the to_4tuple utility function
to_ntuple_dynamic: convert a scalar or iterable into an n-tuple of any length using the to_ntuple utility
